description: Stable Image Services, a comprehensive suite of thirteen specialized image editing tools from Stability AI designed to accelerate professional creative workflows.  Stable Image Services enables granular control over image editing with a range of tools designed to work with your creative process, allowing you to take a single concept from ideation to finished product with precision and flexibility. The Stable Image Search and Replace service is a specific version of inpainting that does not require a mask. Instead, users can leverage a search_prompt to identify an object in simple language to be replaced. The service will automatically segment the object and replace it with the object requested in the prompt.
